message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live air‑quality feeds, so I can’t give you the current AQI for Los Angeles right now.  
If you’d like up‑to‑date information, you can check one of the following:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Visit https://www.airnow.gov/, enter “Los Angeles” and view the latest AQI. |
| **OpenAQ** | Use their API or website (https://openaq.org/) to query recent measurements for LA. |
| **Weather.com / AccuWeather** | Search “Los Angeles air quality” on their sites for a quick snapshot. |
| **Mobile apps** | Apps like “AQICN” or “Plume Labs: Air Report” show real‑time AQI for many cities. |

If you need help interpreting the AQI values or want to know how to mitigate exposure, let me know!
